description: Return code-project manifests for 1-25 existing owned world, model, asset-pack, material, Image, or video/audio assets in one request. Each input is resolved independently and kept in input order: ready entries include the same stable artifact IDs, semantic roles, trustworthy known media metadata, and durable URLs as get_asset_artifact_manifest, while unavailable entries include a typed retryable error. The aggregate summary preserves partial success.
name: get_asset_artifact_manifests
title: Get Asset Artifact Manifests
